period_note: Standalone (solo) basis — same document structure as 2019_Q1/Q2: Condensed CONSOLIDATED Balance Sheet/P&L (pp.2-4, incl. Consolidated total assets 388,612,325,127) followed by the bank's own Condensed [Solo] Balance Sheet/P&L, captioned without 'Consolidated' (pp.7-9) — Solo used per project convention, matching this bank's 2012-2016 and 2021-2025 solo series. Balance sheet identity reconciles exactly: 342,315,300,919 = 306,863,891,901 (total liabilities) + 35,451,409,018 (total equity). Paid-up capital is unchanged from 2019_Q2 at 12,333,753,270 (the H1-2019 ~15% bonus/stock-dividend issue described in 2019_Q2's period_note is now fully reflected in both this and the prior period, with no further change this quarter). Income-statement items below use the Cumulative Jan-to-Sep 2019 column (the filing also separately discloses a discrete 'Quarter ended July to September 2019' column: interest income 7,452,443,367; PAT 1,202,674,179; EPS 0.98 — not recorded as line items here, per this dataset's Q3 cumulative-only convention). P&L reconciles exactly to the taka at every cumulative subtotal: 15,782,493,137 (total operating income) minus 8,478,837,215 (opex) = 7,303,655,922 (profit before provisions), minus 1,126,526,587 (total provision) = 6,177,129,335 (profit before tax), minus 2,410,428,888 (tax) = 3,766,700,447 (net profit after tax). No associates line in the solo P&L, so 'Profit/(loss) before provisions' is recorded once under operating_profit_cumulative (same convention as 2019_Q1/Q2). Dec-2018 solo comparative (total assets 315,416,675,274; total equity 31,637,951,839) again matches the figure reported in the 2019_Q1 and 2019_Q2 filings — no restatement observed across the year. Small equity sub-reserves are not itemized separately (see 2019_Q1 period_note); total_equity is the full reported total inclusive of them. Off-balance-sheet exposures, CRAR, ROE, ROA and AD ratio taken from Solo-basis disclosures (p.8 off-balance-sheet total and NAV; p.13 'Key Financial Indicators (Standalone basis)' and 'Key Financial Ratios (Solo basis)'); ROE/ROA are the source's own annualized figures. Source PDF is a scanned image with no text layer (pdftotext extracts 0 lines) — figures read visually from 150dpi page renders.
